claim: Independent national outlet tested the combos; credits UK account Eat with GG with sparking the recent wave
excerpt: These flavor combo hacks have been shared around the internet for a few years, but an account called Eat with GG seems to have sparked the recent rash of taste-testers.
title: Lemon + Cinnamon = Coke? TikTokers Are Hacking Their Taste Buds, So I Tried It
